svg.title: simparse: public single-file inspection benchmark
svg.desc: COMSOL: 6 files, median 15.6 ms, IR 0.95 KiB; HFSS / AEDT: 3 files, median 12.3 ms, IR 1.21 KiB; Icepak / AEDT: 2 files, median 12.8 ms, IR 1.10 KiB; Maxwell / AEDT: 1 file, median 12.7 ms, IR 1.19 KiB; Mechanical: 3 files, median 16.3 ms, IR 0.95 KiB; Fluent: 4 files, median 14.0 ms, IR 0.66 KiB; Abaqus: 5 files, median 12.3 ms, IR 0.80 KiB; STEP: 2 files, median 27.0 ms, IR 0.94 KiB. Bars show medians; whiskers show file-to-file ranges. Shallow metadata inspection only; IR size is not lossless compression. 1 malformed controls excluded from timing and file counts.
